notes: Boston's business certificate (the DBA filing under M.G.L. c. 110, s. 5). The business address splits into street, city, state and ZIP; P.O. boxes are not allowed. Owners: one per line, 'Full name, residential or corporate address'. The owners sign in front of a notary on the back, so the signature lines and the notary block are left blank; the expiry date and the City Clerk's attestation are the Clerk's.
